info.name: Tickbuddy
info.description:
Tickbuddy is a daily habit and event tracker.
Keep track of what happens each day: your meditation and exercise, how many cups of coffee you had. Your scripts and AI agents can also log automatically, so you can track your nightly backups. Tickbuddy is flexible: use it for habits, chores, keeping an eye on automations, or anything else you want to keep track of. Over time, analyse patterns and statistics with Tickbuddy's built-in analytics.
Your data is stored in Tickbuddy on your Nextcloud server. These companion apps can all read and write the same data: - Tickdroid, the Android app, available on F-Droid - Tickcli, a command-line client for your scripts and automations - TickLLMe, an MCP server that lets your AI agents log and read your entries
info.author: Martin Hammer
